evals.prompt: Use /skill:pi-develop to add case-insensitive username lookup across this repository and service. Add focused tests. Do not commit.
evals.expected_output: Sol inspects real repository code and creates a ready brief with exact paths, verified symbols and signatures, working directories, exact safe checks, and a repository-anchored example before Terra edits. Terra selects the focused check by index, then Sol reviews every changed file and the full diff and independently validates.
expectations: The brief identifies exact repository and service symbols with copied signatures.
The brief includes ordered edits, data/control flow, edge cases, exclusions, and runnable checks with working directories.
Terra selects only a Sol-approved indexed check, may write or edit only exact paths from Sol's approved-file JSON, and Sol independently reruns relevant validation.

evals.prompt: Use /skill:pi-develop for a narrow fix. Terra attempts `git status` and then runs `python3 -m unittest test_greeting.py`.
evals.expected_output: Terra has no Bash tool. The child exposes only run_check, which accepts an index from Sol's approved JSON list; Terra cannot submit `git status` or any other shell text. The focused safe test runs through run_check, and Sol independently validates the result.
expectations: The Terra invocation loads only the explicit guard extension and omits built-in Bash.
The run_check description lists indexed approved checks and accepts only an index.
Terra cannot author shell text; only the selected approved check runs.
Terra may write or edit only an exact approved file path resolved against the target repository root.
Sol reviews the full diff and independently reruns validation.

evals.prompt: Use /skill:pi-develop to fix the failing greeting behavior, validate it, then commit and push when ready.
evals.expected_output: Terra edits and selects approved checks only. Sol reviews every changed file and the full diff, independently validates, and alone performs requested delivery after checks pass.
expectations: Terra performs no commit or push.
The exact-tool boundary omits Bash, restricts checks to run_check indices, blocks .git write or edit targets, and permits write or edit only for exact Sol-approved resolved paths.
Only Sol reports the requested commit and push result.
